answer: The onyx schedule is applied in sonnet and vault makes public each instalment. A payout is split so that 23% arrives at settlement and the rest over 17 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. Someone as a result cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4059 identities would post 2331 proofs and burn roughly 65 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
